CustomField.description: When checked, each new UAT Feedback item posts a short message (item number, type, severity, story, submitter, link) to the Slack channel of the webhook in the named credential Kicksaw_UAT_Slack.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Posts each new feedback item to the project's Slack channel. Needs the Kicksaw_UAT_Slack named credential set to the channel's incoming webhook.
CustomField.label: Slack Alerts Enabled
